relationship_to_restored_text: Interpretive contemplative layer aligned by verse. This does not replace the source-audited restored translation.

verses.mystical_translation: Korahite households begin the gatekeeping divisions.
Meshelemiah's sons are ordered by birth.
Three more sons complete his household.
Obed-edom's first five sons are named.
Three more sons are called blessing, though family size cannot measure every life.
Shemaiah's descendants become capable household leaders.
Skill and reliability are remembered through another generation.
Sixty-two people sustain Obed-edom's service line.
Meshelemiah's household contributes eighteen.
Hosah appoints Shimri chief outside ordinary birth order.
Thirteen relatives complete Hosah's gatekeeping house.
Gate duty is distributed across families.
Small and great enter the same lot process.
Insight and lot place Zechariah at the north gate.
Obed-edom's household watches south and storehouse.
Shuppim and Hosah guard the western approach.
Daily staffing is calculated by direction.
The western colonnade receives its own watch.
Korah and Merari houses complete the gates.
Other Levites oversee treasuries and dedicated property.
Ladan's descendants supply treasury leadership.
Zetham and Joel guard the sacred funds.
Four Levite branches enter the treasury record.
Shebuel, a descendant of Moses, carries financial responsibility rather than prophetic prestige.
Eliezer's line reaches Shelomoth.
Shelomoth's family receives wealth dedicated by king and commanders.
Spoil from war is converted into temple maintenance, but violence remains in the metal.
Gifts from morally complex leaders gather in one treasury without buying innocence.
Izharites handle external administration and judgment.
Hebronites combine sacred and royal oversight west of Jordan.
A late-regnal search identifies leaders in Gilead.
Thousands are placed over eastern tribes in matters of Divine house and king.

contemplative_note: Gates and treasuries can protect community or concentrate exclusion and wealth. The spiritual quality of administration appears in accessibility, transparent records, rotating responsibility, and the refusal to launder war spoil or turn religious officers into police for the throne.
